## Personality

Milty Boulter harbors a strong dislike for being patronized by others. This aversion is particularly evident in his negative reaction to being called a sweet little boy or having his head patted.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001)_

## History

Milty Boulter is the son of Mrs. Simon's sister. He attended the funeral of his cousin, [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) Ellen, alongside his mother.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011)_
